title: if-else-if

lines.explanation:
beginning of a long compound if-else-if statement. This line evaluate whether the value of 'score' is 
greater or equal to 90 and open a block of statement 
that will be executed in this case.
Consequently  'A' will be assigned to 'grade' only if (score >= 90)

if the first test failed (if score < 90), the previous statement will not be execute, instead the program 
jumps here - to the else part, where we test the 
'score' variable again. Now we ask if its value is 
>=80.

Hence, the value of 'grade' will be 'B' only if the first 'if' is 'false' and the second 'if' is true. For example, if 
the value of 'score' is 85, first 'if' will generate 'false' 
and this 'if' will generate 'true'.
If 'score' is not '>= 80' we come here and start testing it for 70.
'grade' becomes 'C' if (score >= 70) and it is less then 80
If (score < 70) we jump here and test if score is greater or equal to 60
However, if none of these if's resulted in true, which means 'score' is less then 60...

...'grade' becomes 'F'.We never get here if any of the previous if's evaluates to true. Only if all them are 
false, we'll end up in this else-branch.
end of the last else branch
printing the resulting value of 'grade'. Since score was initialized to 76 in the beginning, this line will print 'C'.
